report.summary: Chunk 6 of vet.py: skill scanning loop, MCP server vetting, and summarise stub. Claims about deferred .pyc handling, remote fetchers, unpinned versions, egress lanes, and env injection are checked against present code.
risks: deferred loop | medium | Deferred .pyc files are skipped if source was scanned; else added to skipped with message about expected source. Works as described.
mcp.remote_fetch | medium | When command or first arg is in _REMOTE_FETCHERS, a finding is added. The comment says 'fetches code at start-up' – correct for npx/uvx etc. Verdict: kept.
mcp.unpinned | medium | If any token matches _UNPINNED regex, a finding is added. Comment says 'unpinned version or a bare URL'. Regex matches @latest or http(s)://. Verdict: kept.

mcp.egress | medium | Hosts extracted from URLs in command/args are checked via lane_for_host (outside chunk). Finding severity depends on lane. Comment says 'reaches {h}, which sensitivity.lane_for_host calls {lane}'. Verdict: uncheckable because lane_for_host not defined here.
mcp.env_injected | low | If env dict is non-empty, a finding is added. Comment says 'environment values are handed to the server process'. Verdict: kept.

summarise stub | low | Function body incomplete (just `vs = list(verdicts)`). Docstring says 'Counts by outcome, plus the blocking subjects. Sorted; no I/O.' That claim is uncheckable because the function is incomplete.
vet_mcp_server docstring | medium | Docstring says 'Nothing is started or contacted.' That claim is kept – no external calls in this chunk.

vet_mcp_server docstring | medium | Docstring says 'An MCP server is a command line, so what can be judged statically is the command line...' That claim is kept – the function only inspects command/args.

skill scanning notes | low | Note about bundles_code: 'this repo never executes them, but they were scanned as text'. The code scans script_paths as text; execution claim is uncheckable (outside chunk).
